integrity: Analytical argument with independently runnable finite numerical cross-checks; finite tests do not prove the general result. No independent scientific audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Two congruent full-dimensional Euclidean-ball intersections only; no classification of all nonsymmetric distance ellipsoids or intersections of more than two balls. Generic John and Löwner ellipsoid facts and the known covering-ellipsoid derivation are credited. Priority in unindexed literature is not independently established.
title: Exact affine sphericity and optimal ellipsoids of Euclidean two-ball lenses
